Vlogger Norman Mangusin rearrested by PNP-CIDG Nation Vlogger Norman Mangusin rearrested by PNP-CIDG by Elijah Gaven Mitra 19 November 2026 Photo courtesy: Mark Jayson Warnakulahewa﻿ Vlogger Norman Mangusin, popularly known as Francis Leo Marcos, was arrested anew by operatives of the Philippine National Police–Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (PNP-CIDG) on Thursday afternoon, November 19. 
 According to the report of RH Val Gonzales, the arrest was confirmed by National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) Commissioner and Chairperson Rafael Vicente Calinisan, who said Mangusin was apprehended in connection with a case involving the illegal use of uniforms under Article 179 of the Revised Penal Code, in relation to Republic Act No. 10175, or the Cybercrime Prevention Act of 2012. 
 According to Calinisan, the Quezon City Regional Trial Court Branch 224 issued the warrant of arrest, with no bail recommended unless otherwise ordered by the court. 
 Mangusin will be brought to the CIDG headquarters at Camp Crame for booking and processing. 
 Advertisement Prior to his latest arrest, Mangusin had also faced several legal cases, including 12 counts of cyber-related unjust vexation and a complaint involving an alleged violation of Republic Act No. 11917, or the Private Security Services Industry Act.
